policy: Document root cause and exact evidence, add at least two targeted regression cases, refuse unsupported or missing inputs. Never claim self-reported evidence is authenticated GitHub fact.

failures.root_cause: PR #16 lacked owner-authored pre-PR approval metadata and had no bound plan for its exact base SHA; a later comment cannot retroactively prove first local edit approval.
failures.prevention: Before new PR creation require valid plan SHA, exact basis, owner comment, unedited timestamp plan<comment<PR and metadata binding; real GitHub provenance remains checked by existing Required Check.

failures.root_cause: Run #38850603797 failed reading GitHub job logs because gh api rejects terminal escape sequences without --allow-escape-sequences.
failures.prevention: Require explicit gh api --allow-escape-sequences for expected job logs, exact prior error evidence, distinct first attempts and complete run history; reject rerun.
regression_cases: verified log method and distinct run IDs PASS
missing escape handling or rerun BLOCK

failures.root_cause: Merging PR #17 also caused PR #16 (same HEAD) to be marked merged, despite owner intent to leave #16 open.
failures.prevention: Before merge collect all open PRs across paginated GitHub API results and BLOCK when any other open PR shares the target HEAD. Confirm fixed base SHA.
regression_cases: same-head or incomplete PR snapshot BLOCK

failures.root_cause: Run #38916782780 APK compile passed, but verifier expected Signer #1 instead of apksigner's V2 Signer certificate output and incorrectly rejected the matching canonical SHA-256.
failures.prevention: Parse exactly one V2 Signer SHA-256 certificate; require v2 scheme true, signer count 1 and unchanged canonical fingerprint; reject unknown formats and duplicate/missing rows.
regression_cases: wrong fingerprint, multiple signers, v2 false or missing rows BLOCK
